description: A hardened ARM network security group and VNet that should raise nothing
note: The control for the ARM cases: it proves the expectations above come from the template's contents and not from the scanners firing on any ARM file at all. CHANGED after the confirming run 2026-09-22: this was a hardened storage account, which is not achievable. AZU-0056 (blob soft delete), AZU-0057 (logging) and AZU-0058 (geo-redundancy) cannot be cleared on an ARM storage account by configuring what they name -- Trivy's own pass/fail census over 175 real templates has AZU-0057 and AZU-0058 passing zero times, and the adapted state a check receives has accountreplicationtype empty even when the template declares Standard_GRS. The same intent in Terraform clears all three. An NSG and VNet are read correctly by both tools, so the control is built from those instead. See corpus/README.md. Re-verified 2026-09-23 after KICS replaced Trivy on ARM and Bicep: still zero findings from all three tools.
